company_info.company_description: "Ozora Electrical and Renewable Energy (previously known as Platinum Electricians Adelaide & Platinum Electricians Hindmarsh) has been operating in the electrical trade industry for over 10 years, achieving strong and steady business growth since our humble beginnings in early 2014.Our company is triple certified in quality, safety, and environmental management systems; holding ISO9001, ISO14001, and ISO45001 certifications. Upholding these standards, you can trust that we are a reputable company that will not ‘oversell’ you but instead provide expert and honest advice tailored to your needs.Our dedicated team has grown to more than 15 highly skilled staff and tradespeople, all carefully selected based on our core values:Upholding honesty and integrity above all else.Being generous and helping others in need.Commitment to excellence in everything we do.Communication that builds strong relationshipsPursuing personal growth and learning.With a lifetime warranty on all workmanship, a 5-year complete system warranty on all components, and full manufacturer warranties on solar modules, inverters, and batteries, you can enjoy complete peace of mind with your investment.At Ozora Energy, we have the knowledge and expertise to ensure every solar solution is the perfect fit. Each system is designed by SAA accredited designers and installed by our in-house accredited solar and battery technicians. Our tailored solutions include options for additional battery storage, helping you make the most of your energy investment. We also provide ongoing system monitoring via our energy management services.We are proud to serve customers through our offices across Australia:Adelaide HQ1300 069 67213 Fifth Street, Wingfield, SA 5013Sydney Office(02) 8599 794238/51 Nelson Rd, Yennora, NSW 2161Mildura Office(03) 5000 136164 The Crescent, Mildura, VIC 3500For more than a decade, we have delivered exceptional service to our clients, whether in residential solar and battery systems, large-scale commercial solar and storage, or even maritime solar and battery solutions. With Ozora Energy, you can rely on precision workmanship, exceptional customer service, and the confidence of dealing with a team that stands by its work."

reviews.review_description: SigEnergy system fully installed and commissioned in mid-Oct.I'd like to take this opportunity to send a big thank you to the Ozora team from quotation to installation and commissioning.Sales consultant was terrific from the outset -  our first interaction and throughout the design, requirement gathering and quotation process. He was reliable, prompt in answering many many questions and queries, flexible in changing the design and quotation to meet my requirements. When he visited our place for the first time, he took the time to listen to our needs and thoroughly surveyed the house (even took photos of the roof during a wet morning).The installation team did a marvellous job during the three days that they were onsite. The team was well led by the Lead Installer and no question / query was too hard or difficult for the team to assist/answer. They were flexible and happy to listen to my suggestions and we worked collaboratively to ensure our preferences are met where possible.  They involved me in the process and kept me in the loop with progress. The end result is a very neat installation inside my garage with very minimal external cables/conduits showing. They went through all the key components, setup the apps on my phone and clean and takeaway all rubbish.We had a great experience from start to finish. Highly recommend Ozora.

I recently had my solar battery system upgraded by this amazing team, and I couldn’t be happier with the service. Matt from Sydney, Matt from Adelaide, Mitch, and Jonathan were all incredibly professional, friendly, and efficient.They installed a 16 kWh Sungrow battery along with an 8 kW Sungrow inverter to replace my old inverter. The price was very reasonable, and the workmanship was top-notch.A little while after the installation, the system had a minor issue, and they responded extremely quickly to fix it — their after-sales support is just as impressive as their installation work.Highly recommended to anyone looking for a reliable and professional solar installation team!

Good service, only company to come to site and inspect- others quoted sight unseen. Good follow up and installation was very professional. A bit slow with the follow up paperwork being registered but generally happy with follow up post install.

It should be the norm to expect that trained and experienced people will complete the task they are engaged to do in a professional and efficient manner. Our experience with the team from Ozora was exactly that - from quote, installation and follow-up. It is worth noting that Ozora was the only company that came to check out our property during the quote process, which was important to understand potential shading issues and account for some roof infrastructure.The acid test of good a supplier can also be measured by how well they respond to the unexpected. In what proved a more challenging installation than could have been envisaged, Ozora were extremely good. They were quick to respond, provided great communication and solutions and were honest and open in all our discussions.Our interaction with the team from Ozora was first class in aspects and I have absolutely no hesitation in recommending them.

We are pleased to recommend Ozora Energy for your Solar Energy requirements.Jonathan visited the property and ensured a fully professional quote including installation on a terracotta tile roof.The Ozora Team was always timely; doing what they say when they say; they listened to our concerns and partnered with us to ensure the best outcome.The installation team are real troopers - working in all weather to do the job right the first time - taking extra care with the tiles (nil broken) and ensuring nil roof leaks.I had many questions for Jonathan - as the Solar market is crowded and it’s not easy sorting out the cheapies from the professionals.We chose Ozora as it’s a local firm ; long established and is here for the long run to support the warranties.Post installation - they setup the monitoring App and ensured all running perfectly.Regards price, one pays for what one gets; Ozora supplied best quality fittings and frames; first class electrical work; and trimmed the tiles to fit the support roof brackets with no gaps for leaks.Post installation Ozora contacted me to ensure all ok.I am pleased to recommend Ozora Energy for your Solar needs.

We were impressed with all communication from the company and the installation was timely. Grid connection was handled by the company. Staff provided education after the installation around monitoring the system to obtain the most benefits.We are happy to already see a significant decrease in grid energy use since in installation.

The experience with Ozora has been painful. Failed to call back and kept deflecting when questioned.  I have spent hour on the phone with the Network provider and manufacturer. They take no ownership and you have to chase them to get a response.

I spent time with the salesperson, whilst others did not bother to attend. It allowed me to ask all questions and get answers immediately. The price was agreed and the date for installation was set. It all happened as agreed and installers worked quickly and cleanly. No issues with holes in inwalls or rubbish left on site. A clean-looking unit sitting bubbling away in a corner of the garage. The unit is operating well if the details on the app are correct. Will wait for the first account to confirm usefulness. Most happy with price, service and installation

Ozora provided a quote within 24 hours and were ready to install the 6.6kw system within days. Customer service was prompt  and all staff friendly and helpful. Install looks neat and they left no mess behind. The phone App is easy to use and tracks KW production plus more. I would definitely recommend Ozora for anyone looking to go solar and reduce their bills.Wade

After comparing several different quotes, we chose Ozora for the knowledge, expertise and straight forward information supplied by Mitch, as well as the price. All our questions were answered straight away and quotes were detailed and comprehensive. We were also under no pressure and Mitch was always polite and professional. Installation was completed within 7 days of paying the deposit.Mitch was also the installer of the system and he and another technician did an exceptional job, with panels fitted on the roofs of both the house and entertainment area. All work was completed neatly and efficiently in 2 days and the guys worked overtime to ensure the job was done thoroughly and the system up and running. Mitch also gave us some inservice concerning the battery and the app that is to keep track of the system.Ozora helped organise grid connection and Mitch and Matt also answered any of our queries, promptly and efficiently.We highly recommend Ozora.

Matt was easy to talk through about our needs and was flexible to specific requests. I requested horizontal installation of panels post quote due to aesthetics and function; Ozora was happy to oblige for no additional cost. Damon made an effort to keep us informed through installation and Chris kept motoring through some building difficulty and poor weather to get the job done. Thanks Team Ozora.
Elite service - very prompt on installation and helpful with any questions

From the initial quote to the final installation the service provided met all my expectations, folowup queries were immediately dealt with.Great customer service and would be happy to deal with them again. The grid connection was within one week.

We decided to go ahead only with solar panels and Matt was very good to deal and happy to answer all my questions. All the installers were polite, tidy & punctual and they kept us informed at all times
Sales and quoting process was clear and transparent. What was recommended was what i needed. Install was quick and professional with good follow up.
Sales were easy to understand.Installer's were friendly, polite, tidy and punctual.Customer service was easy to follow

All aspects from the first online query to completed installation could not have gone better. The team provided advice based on our current need and not on what they wanted to sell. Not pushy, very helpful and responded to my questions and requirements in an understanding and professional manner.Installed earlier than I thought may be the case which was perfect given the recent heat. Chris and his team mate (sorry for not remembering your name) were excellent to work with during installation.I have the worst roof tiles ever conceived which made things more difficult, but they were so careful and completed a brilliant install. Well done lad's.explained the system and app clearly when completed and took away all the rubbish when they left.The quality of the customer service, installation and standard of work is of the highest order. We could not ask for more.
The sales staff, planners and installers were all punctual, polite, informative, and delivered as promised.

On time, installation quality of a high standard ( I am a trades person so I should know), cheerful and helpful installers.From what I can tell so far, I am optimistic that after sales service is likely to be good.Hard to comment on value for money in a diverse and competitive market, so I'm not sure, but I think it is reasonable for a company with good backup. Price was not the only issue by which I chose this company.

We had spoken with a number of solar providers and always thought it was too hard and the ROI just wasn't there. Then we spoke to Ozora - and they took over the whole process- streamlined from quote to fully functional- You wouldn't even know there were panels on our roof the way they have been placed- so it's not the eyesore that is often associated with panels all over your roof. The guys on site were always on time and polite and took the time to explain what was happening, and another plus there was no "tradie" mess left behind when they had completed the work- they took all the rubbish away and left the space as it was when they arrived. Had we known the process could be this simple we would have made the move to Ozora and solar much earlier!

Matt and the team at Ozora have been absolutely fantastic to work with. I highly recommend them. They have been great at helping my partner and I find the best and most affordable solar/battery option tailored to us and our home.Matt was very supportive and explained everything thoroughly, making sure the solar met our personal needs. Turn around was timely and professional from beginning to end.  We are stoked with our new solar system. Big thanks to Matt and the team!

Configuration of panels on my roof was tricky due to spacing. They were the only one to get all panels on northern aspect neatly.Installers stayed late  to make up for last time due to weather and being down one person than normal. Installer did a good job with refactoring sub board for optimal circuit usage in tight space.System has worked flawlessly sine install a week or so ago.

Matt Nunn was great to deal with, excellent communication. The installation team was friendly, respectful and professional. They seems to take pride in their work to make sure I'd be happy with the install. Overall they did a great job with a very neat and tidy install. The little things we very good too, like making sure they cleaned up properly after their work!I have no hesitation in recommending them.

Matt in the office was my first point of call, who was very professional at every level. Never missed a time or deadline. All paperwork was on time and correct.Communications from Reg in regards to the install was super, kept me up to speed at every step of this.James and Reg were great on the job, did a super job and were fussy just like me when it comes to neatness.Can’t recommend this company enough. “If you want a top job then employ a top company.”

Dealt with solar expert Matthew for our solar and battery installation. Matt and his supporting team were very professional, informative and kept the a great level of communication up throughout the process. Matts electrical knowledge and personal nature, helped me understand the ins and outs of the solar system. Would highly recommend using Matt and his team for a Reliable and professional service.

Matt Nunn was brilliant throughout the whole process. Happy to answer all of my annoying questions, RE-quote my many requests for system alterations and gave us excellent pricing. The install was organised super fast & Chris, Nick & the install team were friendly, punctual, tidy & a pleasure to deal with. They did an outstanding job. They even put our inverter in our shaded garage as a late request. I highly recommend Platinum Electricians for your solar system!

Matthew Nunn looked after us form the first point of contact. He answered our questions and provided a thorough quote. The price was competitive. Unlike other pushy companies, dealing with Platinum Solar was easy. Once the date was booked, we paid the deposit & the team arrived on time on the day. A reliable and honest provider. Happy to recommend!

Matt Nunn came out to give us a quote. He was very informative and explained everything to us. He gave us options with or without a battery and at no stage did we feel pressured into purchasing anything.Matt was 100% honest with us and his quote was sent to us when he said it would (and came in cheaper than our other quotes for the same product)Our system was installed when they said it would be installed and the installation team lead by Mitch were all very respectful and made sure everything was clean and tidy when completed. I could not fault the whole process in any way.

Matt from Platinum contacted me promptly after signing up to get my quotes and was exceptionally friendly and helpful with figuring out what I wanted from my system and accommodating my choice of panels and the best overall system size to fit my roof. The quote process was fast and easy and we chose Platinum over the others based on the quality and attention to detail they were offering.The day of installation the guys were right on time and lead installer Mitch went through with me what was going to happen and to take any requests I had. The initial panels I requested weren't available on the day but they did have the same model in a slightly lower rated wattage, but to compensate they offered to spend some time rearranging the layout on my roof so they could fit an extra panel to make up the shortfall. Both Matt and Mitch were very accommodating to help make me reassured with what was happening.The installers did a great job, with neat and tidy cable work, and left things nice and clean afterwards. Overall I am very happy I chose Platinum Electricians for my solar installation.

Some feedback on the installersTurned up on time.Very receptive happy to answer any question.Unbelievably all completed in one day.If you can pass on my thanks to your team, we should acknowledge excellent customer service, this also includes yourself.Kind regardsSteve

Highly recommend the team at Platinum. Matt explained everything in great detail and answered any questions I had. The installation team was on time and tidy. Couldn’t be happier with my solar system.

Fantastic service and installationMatt was very quick to contact us, visit us, explain everything in detail and provide a VERY competitive quote. We accepted, and Platinum's admin staff quickly arranged an installation date. They kept us well informed through the whole process, and Matt replied promptly to the many questions I sent him in the lead up to our installation date.They removed our old system and installed the new system in a very professional manner. They did an exceptionally neat job of installation - both inside and outside the roof space. Mitch (the lead installer) was brilliant to work with, and he explained everything, and where there were decisions to make regarding the best placement of panels, he talked that through with me. Both Mitch and Matt went out of their way to make sure I was happy with the installation - Huge thankyou for that. The rest of the installation team were also excellent workers and always friendly and courteous.  I can VERY highly recommend Platinum Electricians for Solar Installations.

To Platinum Electricians,From the first consult with Matt I had no doubt and full trust for Matt and his Platinum Electricians Teams to install my solar panels. Matt was fantasic, pleasant and explained all my concerns and answered all my queries in the most professional manner and without hesitation. My installation was completed by Mitchell within 2 days by professionals to a very high standard and when upon completion everything was explained, and how the operation to the inverter functions.I would like to thank Matt, Mitchell, and his team from Platinum Electricians and would truly recommend this company to anyone looking for Solar.Thanks again,Luigi Impala
The team made everything easy; they arrived on time - quote was clear and easy to understand and price was very competitive.Highly recommend
The team at platinum exceeded our expectations with our solar install, the whole process was seamless and very well priced. We are very happy with the end result!

A representative came to the property and talked through my expectations and answered all of my questions which was also well supported in the quote. They were very clear about the installation process and the design etc.The installers where on time and very polite and tidy. There was a bit of an issue identified due to the age of my house. However a swift resolution and alternative plan was agreed. The installers and the sales rep worked through the situation and the work was completed within the time advised. The installers also went through the set up and app.Platinum Electrical organised everything including the grid connection after the install.Apart from the overcast weather all is operating as expected.Very pleased with the whole process and definitely recommend Platinum Electrical. Very professional operators.

Matt and the boys from platinum were amazing, Unfortunately due to the weather we're unable to complete the install in one day but Kept me informed throughout the whole process and came back to finish the job in a reasonable time. The boys on-site were very polite and professional and took me through the process of how to download and use the app to monitor my solar. And while this was all going on the lady back in the office was taking care of the paperwork for my engery provider. So I literally didn't have to do a thing. It was all taken care of for me. They even did a couple of other jobs for me while they were here.Thanks againWould highly recommend them.
The sales quoting was very efficient and the installation staff were fantastic.Highly recommended.Special note that this company does not try and also sell monitoring software like others do!

I requested an on site visit as part of my solar quote process, and the Platinum salesman was on time to within a minute of the agreed time. Matt was personable, knowledgeable and able to tailor his pitch at varying technical levels to reduce tech anxiety. He was able to adjust the quote and also gave options regarding brands, which was reassuring. All liaising with energy suppliers was taken care of and they were able to explain the new rules regarding solar feed in restrictions simply.The install team was on time, tidy and the work was carried out by inhouse installers to a high standard. Mitch took personal responsibility and followed up the minor glitches setting up the app and answering operating questions.I couldn't be any happier with the process

Matt Nunn was the first (very quick) to respond after I got the 3 recommendations from SolarQuotes. He was quick to answer all my questions and to give me 2 quotes for a 6.6 Kw and 10 Kw systems on request. When he came for an on-site inspection he gave me good information that helped me decide which system to get. The installation date was as planned. They organised the grid connection promptly. Mitchell Riley and his team were great in the installation and very prompt to answer follow up questions regarding the inverter app on the day of meter upgrade. Matthew and Tania, admin staff were excellent too and made me feel like I am a platinum client! I am very happy to recommend Platinum Electricians Hindmarsh to my family and friends.
Fantastic customer support from Matt, first fix has been completed and the service and communication has been fantastic!

Young Matt answered all my questions relating to the solar package which I agreed too plus on the installation and was quite polite in manner! The crew conducted them else’s well and answered any questions I had on the day and concluded within two days.

We were very pleased with Platinum Electricians Hindmarsh. They were great with explaining everything before we decided to go with them. Got all information through email same day. Compared to all other Solar systems we got quoted they were the best priced for what we wanted. The installation was awesome the two young guys that came out did a really great job and always answered any questions that we had. They explained everything that they were doing and were very efficient on doing there job. Would gladly recommend them. The customer service we received was extremely good and even after we had our installation you can phone and they respond really quickly. We are very happy to have picked them

The team at Platinum Electricians Hindmarsh were fantastic to work with and I would highly recommend them to both family and friends.It started with a site visit from Matt who gave me all the information I needed to choose between several different panel and inverter brands.On installation day Caleb and the boys arrived on time, they were polite and did a fantastic job.I couldn’t of asked for a better team to install my system.

Platinum Electricians were fantastic to deal with  from the first contact. Matthew organised an onsite inspection promptly, which he attended (and was to the second on time).Quoting procedure was quick, clean and easy. There was no sales pitch to buy a battery I didn't want (or need). Platinum's team designed a system and layout to fit our roof space and deliver what was required, with the option to piggyback in  a battery and car charger at a later point if desired. I organised half a dozen quotes before proceeding , Platinum was neither the cheapest nor the dearest in flat dollar terms. In real dollar terms I believe Platinum to be exceptional value  as the process was incident free, prompt and installation was precise. They have used high quality components and their installation team lead by Mitchell were fantastic. Keeping in line with the whole process the install team were punctual, polite , hardworking and delivered quality workmanship that they took great pride in. Other than the solar panels and the inverter they did not even leave foot prints you could see!  When the job was completed our property was exactly as it was before they arrived. Given it was cold and sleety rain for a fair part of the second day it could have been very easy to duck off  early and perhaps take a few short cuts but the installation team stayed well after standard finishing times to ensure the job was completed in the quoted time frames and that everything was spotless for which  we are very appreciative. Well done Platinum.

The quotation came in very promptly,The installer was very punctual, tidy, and pleasant to deal with.Overall it was an excellent process, despite one solar panel broken in transit somewhere and causing some delays.

Fantastic installation on both Panels and Battery, Matt was so helpful and easy to deal with, certainly will get Platinum Electrical for further Electrical work,  The Team are very helpful and knowledgeable with current solar trends.Platinum Electrical remained competitive with both Panels Battery and installation, Well done guys

We were quickly contacted by three companies to provide quotes but Platinum promptly arranged a time to come visit our home, assess the site and sit down and ask and answer all the relevant questions to get to know our current solar requirements and those we anticipate in the future.Within days of accepting their quote they were on site and installing the panels, inverters and battery.Installers were always on time, knowledgeable, polite and kept us informed throughout the process even in the searing heat on a hot tin roof.Grid connection was arranged by them via our electricity provider but is still ongoing, through no fault of Platinum, as there has been an extended wait time for SA Power Networks to attend the property.Next week we'll flick the switch and be on our way to no/low bills and always on power.

The quote process was excellent.  Matt arrived on time, came out to the house, listened (we had an existing system), and tailored the solution.They replaced my existing PV system and inverter at no cost, and they guaranteed the materials will be recycled as much as possible.Platinum themselves do the work, and they pride themselves on that.Very polite, professional.  Provided advice on covers.There was great follow-up customer service.  I had queries about the reading on the app etc.The guys left the place in a cleaner state that it was.  It was nice to hear the chat and banter as they seemed to enjoy their work.

Could not fault from initial contact in obtaining quote to installation, prompt, excellent customer service and help with the paperwork along the way.  Great installers, very polite and tidy with their work. Very happy overall.

The quote process was same day (!) and genuinely informative and paced at a techno level that was ok for me. Clearly he could have  gone geek or simpler if he wanted. Good explanation of how things work that allowed the right product to emerge naturally. The office was a pleasure to call and they were totally on top of the process. The boss was always available and never rushed. The young men who did the installation were a pleasure to have around: smart, quiet, efficient and worked steadily over two days. And they handled a difficult neighbour with great diplomacy, beyond expectation. A neat job nicely positioned, and a thorough cleanup that showed no hint they had even been there.
Matt was quick to respond, turned up on time and had a quote tailored to what we had discussed to me very quickly. The installers were equally punctual and great to deal with.

The process was smooth and fast from beginning to end. The communication was very quick and clear. Any questions I had were answered promptly. The installation was fast and the workers were conscious of my sleeping children. The explanation of how it works and to use the app was great. I would recommend to family and friends. It looks phenomenal.

The whole process was a great experience, from the initial enquiry, purchase of the system, then installation. All those involved were knowledgeable, courteous, friendly and efficient. Any questions I had were fully explained, the organizing of the installation was efficient and the installation itself professional and tidy. I would certainly recommend Platinum Electricians.
From start till finish, the process took less than a month.The installation went smoothly and was completed in a day.Job well done.

I highly recommend Platinum Electricians Hindmarsh for installation of solar and all electrical needs. I’m an extremely demanding and fastidious customer and my expectations were met in full….the Hindmarsh Team care.From quote, though install and connection, an absolute seamless process. The support and communication was exceptional.

Matt and the team were fantastic from start to finish. Always super responsive and took care of everything along the way. Was able to get ours done quickly to take advantage of as much of the summer as possible.

Fantastic experience dealing with Matt Nunn from Platinum Electricians.He came to the house promptly after being contacted to provide a quote. The quote was emailed that night and an install date provided in line with my date request. Once I had paid the deposit it was all confirmed.The installers were on time, worked quickly, left the place clean and tidy and by the end of the day our system was up and going. A couple of our roof tiles were cracked in the process due to being old and brittle and the boys sourced some and replaced and even left us with a few spare! All within install day!Matt emailed that night to follow up and provided us with photos of the installation and organised the grid connection with our energy provider so we didn't have to.Easy, quick and hassle freeWe are looking forward to seeing our energy savings!

We have just upgraded our solar system and couldn't be happier. The process was really easy and Matt's customer service, knowledge and attentiveness was 5 star. Everyone at Platinum were really easy to deal with and answered all my questions quickly and attentively. Platinum handled all the paperwork and submissions and installed our new system with no hassles. The installation boys were champs, getting onto our roof and spending the whole day in the incredible heat to ensure our system was installed as promised. I would highly recommend Platinum Electricians Hindmarsh to handle your solar installation - excellent service from start to finish.Sorry I cant include what their service is like for any issues because we haven't had any....

The whole process was very easy and professional. Everyone was polite and efficient and punctual. The installers went the extra mile and left the place clean.I would highly recommend Platinum Electricians Hindmarsh.

Every step went like clockwork - knowledgeable sales people for my complicated installation, competitive price, punctual and tidy installation, and easy after-sales support. I'd highly recomment Matt & the team at Platinum Electricians.

Matt was fantastic right from the beginning.  His communication was clear and made you understand everything.  He assured me that he would be my go to guy should I experience any issues later and not a call centre.  Installation was arranged for 22 Dec but then received a call from Matt on 19 Decto say they had a cancellation for the next day and if they could install . A team of 5 guys arrived on time and got to work. By the afternoon the system was operational.   Matt did a follow-up call after installation and again in January after he returned from holidays.  So far I am extremely happy.  Will definitely add the battery later when the ROI has improved.
Did quote over phone,knew what I wanted,sent me photo of plan and quote I was happy with

From the sales process right until the end result. I could not be happier with both Matthew, during the quoting process and James, who was head installer. They both explained the use and benefits of the app after hours, as I had to work late day of install. It all came together so well and overall couldn’t be any happier! Thanks again guys!!
